title: PH6 Evidence Chain Block v1
description: Lane 1 sovereign evidence packet with blockchain-style chaining. seq + prev_hash + canon_hash establish ordering independent of timestamp. Hash width (64 hex) is BLAKE2b-256 — pattern is width-only, does not imply SHA-256.

created_at.description: Temporal context only. Authoritative ordering is derived from seq + prev_hash.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number. Primary ordering authority per Section 1.3 Time Authority Doctrine.

prev_hash.description: BLAKE2b-256 of previous block. Width 64 hex. SHA-256 forbidden for authority fields.

canon_hash.description: BLAKE2b-256 canonical authority hash of this block.
